text: On August 29, 2019, the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee elected two Co-chairs for a term of office ending December 31, 2020 and until successors are appointed. The Committee will elect two Co-chairs for a term of office ending November 14, 2022.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee: 1. Elected Pamela Hart and Bryan Winters as Co-Chairs of the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee for a term of office ending November 14, 2022.
